name: John Summit
description: John Summit began his career as an accountant, but it was music that landed him in the New York Stock Exchange. He played a historic show there in September inspired by his 2026 ‘CTRL ESCAPE’ LP, also ushering in the second edition of Experts Only festival. His label’s signature two-day event returned to NYC, bringing 60,000 fans and a genre-spanning line-up reflecting Summit’s versatility and tastes (don’t sleep on SUBJOHNICS — his side project alongside dubstep titan, Subtronics.) Now, Summit is tearing through his biggest tour yet, packing arenas from Los Angeles to Brooklyn, where revellers can celebrate his multi-faceted journey from cubicle to clubland.
styles: “Peaks and valleys. I treat my sets like a movie where I come in hot, get in a groove, and have highlights throughout.”
best_known_for: “Anthemic songs and non-stop energy on the decks. No matter what, it’s always a party.”
